latin: Essentia cuiuslibet intelligentiae est substantialiter ad aliquid.
translation: The essence of any intelligence stands, substantially, in relation to something else.
translation_note: 'ad aliquid' is the Aristotelian category of relation; cf. farmer1998:13516 note on 'relations'.
